facts.text: Evan mentioned that going on beach sunsets is a low-impact exercise that is good for exercise and totally calming.

evidence.quote: By the way there are plenty of other low-impact exercises that can be fun. Going on beach sunsets is one of my favorites - good for exercise and totally calming.

facts.text: Sam expressed interest in going for beach walks and mentioned having a recurring dream about flying over skyscrapers.

evidence.quote: Gonna go for some beach walks - thanks for the tip, Evan! I want to brag, I had that recurring dream again where I'm flying over skyscrapers!

facts.text: Evan encouraged Sam to keep practicing and mentioned that controlling the recurring dream might come with more practice.

evidence.quote: I think a little more and you'll learn how to control those dreams, once you get the hang of it let me know haha!

facts.text: Sam thanked Evan for the advice and expressed a desire to make the most of the beach walk.

evidence.quote: Thanks Evan! Gonna make the most of it. You too, have a good one!
